B. rostroventral

The four connectivity parcels dissociate very cleanly on emotion selectivity versus raw magnitude, and the question is explicitly about purity, not strength.

Rostroventral dmPFC is the ventral limbic-coupled node of the parcellation. Resting-state and meta-analytic connectivity places it preferentially with amygdala, anterior insula, ventral striatum, vmPFC/vACC and subgenual cingulate, and it is relatively decoupled from dorsal attention, fronto-parietal control and mentalizing networks. On emotion > non-emotion contrasts it consistently shows the highest emotion-to-non-emotion response ratio / selectivity / purity index of the four dmPFC parcels: strong, relatively restricted recruitment by affective, valence and socio-emotional content with markedly reduced co-recruitment by executive control, working memory, conflict monitoring and theory-of-mind tasks.

That is the classic pure-but-not-strongest dissociation. Absolute BOLD amplitude to emotional stimuli is numerically larger in the dorsal/caudal parcels. Rostrodorsal dmPFC is the domain-general mentalizing/control node with large raw amplitudes but low emotion selectivity. Caudal-right is functionally multiplexed with dorsal attention/salience/executive/somatomotor networks so even when the raw response to affectively salient stimuli is high the activation is shared with non-affective salience, attention and control demands, giving it low emotion purity. Caudal-left similarly shows a large mean emotion-evoked magnitude but the response is mixed across affective and broader socio-cognitive contrasts.

Rostroventral therefore provides the most functionally specific, limbic-predominant emotion signature in dmPFC, i.e. the most purely emotion-activated subregion of the four, even though its peak absolute activation is smaller than that seen in caudal-left and caudal-right. Occipital cortex is not a dmPFC parcel.

4.text:
PRIVATE REFLECTION: The question is about emotion selectivity/purity within the four connectivity-based dmPFC parcels, not maximal raw emotion amplitude, and occipital is anatomically irrelevant.

Four parcels consistently referenced: rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left, caudal-right.

Current consensus after round 2 is unanimous B. rostroventral.

Key profile converging across rounds:
* Rostroventral dmPFC is the ventral limbic-coupled node. Resting-state/meta-analytic connectivity preferentially links it with ventral/limbic affective circuitry – amygdala, anterior insula, ventral striatum, vmPFC/ventral ACC/subgenual cingulate – and it is relatively decoupled from dorsal attention/fronto-parietal control/theory-of-mind networks.
* Task/meta-analytic profiling gives it the highest emotion-to-non-emotion response ratio/ selectivity/purity index of the four parcels: disproportionate engagement by affective/valence/socio-emotional content with markedly reduced co-recruitment by executive control, working memory, conflict monitoring, theory-of-mind/mentalizing.
* Absolute BOLD magnitude to emotional stimuli is smaller than in more dorsal/caudal nodes – classic magnitude vs purity dissociation.

Magnitude facts now stably acknowledged:
* Rostrodorsal dmPFC = domain-general mentalizing/control node, strong fronto-parietal / theory-of-mind coupling, large raw amplitudes to emotional/social stimuli but low emotion selectivity/purity.
* Caudal-right dmPFC = multiplexed with dorsal attention/salience/somatomotor/executive control; can reach large absolute affective amplitudes but functionally mixed, low purity.
* Caudal-left dmPFC = magnitude-dominant node in the dmPFC set, largest mean emotion-evoked effect size/magnitude for emotion, broadly responsive to affective and non-affective socio-cognitive/evaluative contrasts; mixed profile, low purity.

Earlier minority purity claim for D. caudal-left from round 0 has been revised by those colleagues. Left-lateralized caudal affective vs cognitive dissociation was reframed as magnitude-dominant, not purity-dominant. Remaining tension resolved: caudal-left = strongest magnitude, rostroventral = purest selectivity.

Phrasing “most purely activate by emotion processing even if it is not the area most strongly activated by such stimuli” matches rostroventral profile: high emotion purity with lower absolute amplitude.

Unresolved minimal; keep tracking caudal-left magnitude dominance literature and caudal-right large raw amplitude but multiplexed, to avoid conflating magnitude with purity in later rounds.

PRIVATE REFLECTION: The question is explicitly about emotion selectivity/purity not raw emotion magnitude within the four connectivity-based dmPFC parcels: rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left, caudal-right. Occipital is an anatomical distractor.

Round 0 split between rostroventral purity camp and minority caudal-left purity camp. Round 1 and current round 2 show full convergence to B. rostroventral; colleagues 1,10,12 switched from D caudal-left in round 0 to B rostroventral.

Current consensus view:

* Rostroventral dmPFC = ventral affective/limbic node. Resting-state and meta-analytic connectivity preferentially with amygdala, anterior insula, ventral striatum, vmPFC/vACC/subgenual cingulate and relatively decoupled from dorsal attention/fronto-parietal control and theory-of-mind/mentalizing networks. Task/meta-analytic profiling gives highest emotion-to-non-emotion response ratio/ selectivity/purity index of the four parcels: disproportionate recruitment by affective/valence/socio-emotional content with markedly reduced co-recruitment by executive control, working memory, conflict monitoring, mentalizing. Classic pure-but-not-strongest dissociation: absolute BOLD magnitude to emotional stimuli is smaller than in more dorsal/caudal nodes.

* Rostrodorsal dmPFC = domain-general mentalizing/control node. Strong coupling to fronto-parietal/dorsal ACC/lateral prefrontal theory-of-mind networks. Largest raw task-evoked amplitudes to emotional/social stimuli, but low emotion vs non-emotion selectivity; co-activated by mentalizing, cognitive control, value/reward.

* Caudal-right dmPFC = multiplexed with dorsal attention/salience/somatomotor/executive networks. Can reach large absolute BOLD amplitude to affectively salient stimuli but activation is shared with non-affective salience/attention/control demands; low emotion purity.

* Caudal-left dmPFC = magnitude-dominant node in the set. Largest mean emotion-evoked effect size/raw amplitude for emotion in dmPFC; broadly responsive to affective and non-affective socio-cognitive demands, mixed affective-cognitive profile, lower purity than rostroventral.

Magnitude and selectivity dissociate: caudal-left is the strongest raw activator for emotion, rostrodorsal/caudal-right also show large raw amplitudes, but rostroventral is the most purely emotion-selective subregion of the four. No remaining disagreement on purity; key factual nuance to retain is pure-but-not-strongest dissociation and specific connectivity fingerprints for each parcel.

2.text:
PRIVATE REFLECTION: The four connectivity-based dmPFC parcels are rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left and caudal-right; occipital is anatomically irrelevant.

Core dissociation now stable across rounds is magnitude vs selectivity/purity. The question asks for sub-region most purely activated by emotion processing even if not most strongly activated.

Rostroventral dmPFC:
* Preferentially coupled at rest and meta-analytically with ventral/limbic affective circuitry – amygdala, ventral striatum, ventral anterior cingulate/vmPFC, anterior insula, subgenual cingulate – and relatively decoupled from dorsal attention/fronto-parietal control and theory-of-mind networks.
* Consistently described as having the highest emotion-to-non-emotion response ratio / emotion selectivity/purity index of the four parcels: disproportionately driven by affective/valence/socio-emotional content with markedly reduced co-recruitment by executive control, working memory, conflict monitoring and mentalizing tasks.
* Absolute BOLD magnitude to emotional stimuli is smaller than in more dorsal/caudal nodes. Classic pure-but-not-strongest pattern.

Rostrodorsal dmPFC:
* Domain-general cognitive/mentalizing/control node, strongly coupled to lateral prefrontal/fronto-parietal control and theory-of-mind networks.
* Can show large raw task-evoked amplitudes to emotional/social stimuli but low emotion selectivity because co-activated by mentalizing, cognitive control, task demand, value/reward.

Caudal parcels:
* More dorsal/caudal, coupled with dorsal attention/salience/executive systems; functionally multiplexed.
* Caudal-right is especially multiplexed with salience/motor/dorsal attention and executive control; can reach large raw affective amplitudes but low purity.
* Caudal-left is the magnitude-dominant node: largest mean emotion-evoked magnitude/effect size in the dmPFC set, broadly responsive to both affective and non-affective socio-cognitive contrasts. Not the pure node.

Deliberation history:
Round 0 split 8/11 for B rostroventral vs minority 3 for D caudal-left, disagreement on purity vs magnitude. Round 1 public responses unanimous: all 9 colleagues who spoke endorse B rostroventral, including Colleagues 1,10,12 who previously argued for D caudal-left. Four parcels consistently referenced are rostroventral, rostrodorsal, caudal-left, caudal-right.

Current consensus after round 4 is unanimous B. rostroventral. All 9 colleagues now select B, same as round 3 unanimity.

Key profile converging:
* Rostroventral dmPFC is the ventral limbic-coupled node. Resting-state/meta-analytic connectivity preferentially links it with ventral/limbic affective circuitry – amygdala, anterior insula, ventral striatum, vmPFC/vACC/subgenual cingulate – and it is relatively decoupled from dorsal attention/fronto-parietal control/theory-of-mind networks.
* Task/meta-analytic profiling gives it the highest emotion-to-non-emotion response ratio/selectivity/purity index of the four parcels: disproportionate engagement by affective/valence/socio-emotional content with markedly reduced co-recruitment by executive control, working memory, conflict monitoring, theory-of-mind/mentalizing.
* Absolute BOLD magnitude to emotional stimuli is smaller than in more dorsal/caudal nodes – classic magnitude vs purity dissociation.

Magnitude facts stably acknowledged:
* Rostrodorsal dmPFC = domain-general mentalizing/control node, strong fronto-parietal / theory-of-mind coupling, large raw amplitudes to emotional/social stimuli but low emotion selectivity/purity.
* Caudal-right dmPFC = multiplexed with dorsal attention/salience/somatomotor/executive control; can reach large absolute affective amplitudes but functionally mixed, low purity.
* Caudal-left dmPFC = magnitude-dominant node in the dmPFC set, largest mean emotion-evoked effect size/magnitude for emotion, broadly responsive to affective and non-affective socio-cognitive/evaluative contrasts; mixed profile, low purity.

Earlier minority purity claim for D. caudal-left from round 0 has been fully revised by those colleagues. Left-lateralized caudal affective vs cognitive dissociation was reframed as magnitude-dominant, not purity-dominant. Remaining tension resolved: caudal-left = strongest magnitude, rostroventral = purest selectivity.

Phrasing “most purely activate by emotion processing even if it is not the area most strongly activated by such stimuli” matches rostroventral profile: high emotion purity with lower absolute amplitude.

Unresolved minimal; continue tracking caudal-left magnitude dominance literature and caudal-right large raw amplitude but multiplexed, to avoid conflating magnitude with purity in later rounds.
